'''2019 EGP Joe Phillips LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Phillips]] at [[2019 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Phillips]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HB Phillips LS 2019 EGP.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127124159/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
